clusters.name: Snack/drink vending machine route
clusters.description: Place and restock snack, drink or full-line vending machines at workplaces, apartments and busy locations, earning product sales minus location commission.

clusters.name: Ice and water vending kiosks
clusters.description: Own unattended ice and/or purified-water vending kiosks on leased sites, earning per-bag/per-gallon sales minus rent or revenue share.

clusters.name: Cash ATM placement
clusters.description: Place cash ATMs at cash-heavy businesses and earn surcharge and interchange fees, sharing some with the host.

clusters.name: Crypto ATM hosting
clusters.description: Host an operator's crypto ATM in a store in exchange for revenue share or flat monthly payment.

clusters.name: Automated pizza vending
clusters.description: Place heated pizza vending machines in dorms, gyms and late-night locations, selling hot pizzas per unit.

clusters.name: Coin-op amusement placements in venues
clusters.description: Place coin-op amusements (kiddie rides, pool tables, dart boards, claw machines, jukeboxes, photo booths) in bars, stores and malls on a revenue split with the venue.

clusters.name: Coin-counting kiosks
clusters.description: Supply coin-counting kiosks to grocery chains and credit unions, earning per-transaction consumer fees shared with the host.

clusters.name: Oxygen bar kiosk
clusters.description: Place an oxygen bar station in day spas on a revenue share with the host.

clusters.name: Perfume/cologne spray vending
clusters.description: Place machines that dispense a cologne spray for a small per-use payment.

clusters.name: Niche product vending machines
clusters.description: Buy or retrofit vending machines to sell a specific niche product (disc golf discs, campus product) at a targeted location, earning product sales.

clusters.name: Mystery-package vending machines
clusters.description: Sell returned/lost packages as mystery boxes via vending machines in busy venues, possibly sharing revenue with hosts.

clusters.name: Parking lot with used pay stations
clusters.description: Lease a parking lot and operate it with cheaply bought used pay stations, earning parking fees.

clusters.name: Gold-melting vending machines
clusters.description: Kiosks that melt customers' gold and deposit cash value to their bank account.

clusters.name: Unstaffed small-town grab-and-go store
clusters.description: Key-fob access, card-pay unattended retail store for tiny towns skipped by dollar stores, earning retail sales.
